info.title: Traceway
info.description: One API. A call returns the signed-in person's own data, or a course opened with a signed link. There is no list of other people. A password, two-factor secret, recovery code, or remember token is never returned.

422.description: The points are not enough, or the roads miss one.

502.description: Those points did not join along the roads.

delete.summary: Delete one of the signed-in person's routes
delete.description: A route owned by someone else is rejected.

403.description: The route belongs to someone else.

post.summary: Download a FIT course for the signed-in person

get.summary: Download a shared course as GPX

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: The signature on the share link.

get.summary: Download a shared course as FIT

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: The signature on the share link.

get.summary: Download one leg of a shared multisport plan as FIT

parameters.name: leg
parameters.description: The leg, counted from 1. The swim has no course.

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: The signature on the share link.

200.description: A FIT file named for the leg.
Paths on this host. They do not name a person.

post.summary: Draw every leg of a brick, duathlon, or triathlon

422.description: The transition or a leg is not valid.

502.description: A leg did not come back.

422.description: The pin or the length is not valid.

get.summary: Download the signed-in person's own data
get.description: The file is that person only. The password, two-factor secret, recovery codes, and remember token are withheld.

200.description: A JSON file of the signed-in account and their routes.

delete.summary: Delete the signed-in person and their saved routes

409.description: The account is gone and the browser is sent home.

422.description: The password does not confirm the deletion.

patch.summary: Update the signed-in person's name and email

422.description: The name or email is not valid.

302.description: The password was changed. The new password is not returned.

422.description: The current password does not match, or the new password is too weak.

get.description: Requires a signed URL. The page shows the course, not the owner.

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: The signature on the share link.

post.summary: Move a point onto the nearest road or path
Save a route for the signed-in person

200.description: The saved route id and its signed share URL.

Error.description: A call that did not succeed. A validation failure also lists one message per field.

errors.description: Present when a field failed validation. The key is the field name.

legs.description: The legs of a multisport plan, in order. Empty for a single sport.

color.description: The colour picked for the leg, as #rrggbb.

BuildRouteRequest.description: The points to join, and how the roads should be chosen.

ExportFitCourseRequest.description: The course to write into a FIT file.

leg.description: The leg of a multisport plan. The course is named after it, such as "Brick 2 Run".

PreviewMultisportRequest.description: The transition, an optional swim, and the land legs in order.

stretch.description: A chained leg covers distance_metres on the way to its finish, rather than taking the shortest way.

PreviewRouteRequest.description: The pin, the sport, and the length.

PasswordUpdateRequest.description: The current password and the replacement. Neither is returned.

ProfileDeleteRequest.description: Confirms the deletion. The password is not returned.

password.description: Confirms the deletion. It is not stored in the response.

ProfileUpdateRequest.description: The name and email of the signed-in person.

SnapPointRequest.description: A point and the sport used to choose a road or a path.

StoreSavedRouteRequest.description: The route the signed-in person wants to keep.

layout.description: How the legs of a multisport plan meet.

legs.description: The legs of a multisport plan, in order. The swim, if any, comes first.

color.description: The colour picked for the leg, as #rrggbb.

session.description: The session cookie of the signed-in person. State-changing calls also send the X-XSRF-TOKEN header. A signed share link does not use this cookie.
session.name: laravel_session
